visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female with black wavy hair, wearing a colorful semi-transparent mesh top over a white shirt, stands next to a male with brown hair in a black t-shirt. They are in a studio setting with softboxes and shelves visible. The female gives a thumbs up and smiles at the camera. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a hand holding a small transparent plastic box containing several white and blue single-use capsules. The lighting is bright, emphasizing the product's small size and packaging details. (3) The scene alternates between shots of the two individuals talking and a split-screen view. The male holds a brown burlap bag. They use hand gestures while discussing the item, with variety-show style text appearing at the bottom. (4) A detailed close-up shows a hand pouring fine white powder from a small capsule onto a palm. The skin texture and the granularity of the powder are clearly visible under studio lights. (5) Both the male and female are shown laughing together in a split-screen layout. They exhibit high energy and expressive facial movements. (6) A final graphic card appears, showing a portrait of the male, social media search text, and a slogan, set against a dark background with orange accents.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an energetic greeting from a female voice, accompanied by an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM with a clear, steady beat. (2) A male voice enters the conversation as a light rustling sound of plastic capsules being moved is heard. The interaction is rapid and lively. (3) The two voices overlap slightly as they discuss the product features; the female's pitch is consistently higher and more expressive. (4) A soft rustling and clicking sound occurs as a capsule is handled and opened. The BGM maintains a constant presence, providing a cheerful atmosphere. (5) Laughter from both speakers breaks out, characterized by high arousal and sharp vocal transients, while the music continues at an even volume. (6) The vocal density remains high until the very end, where the BGM concludes alongside the final verbal sign-off, transitioning into a short musical tail for the outro card.
